    ["datos.html", "💾", "Datos y fuentes", "Descarga en CSV, códigos de Eurostat y ejemplos en R y Python.", "investigacion", TODOS, "epi"],

  ];
  const G = [["", "Todas"], ["GADE", "GADE y dobles grados"], ["GECO", "GECO"], ["GFICO", "GFICO"], ["GMIM", "GMIM"], ["GTUR", "GTUR y TITUR"], ["POS", "Másteres y doctorado"]];
  const P = [["", "Todos"], ["e", "Estudiantado"], ["p", "Profesorado"], ["i", "Investigación"]];
  const par = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
  const est = {tipo: T[par.get("tipo")] ? par.get("tipo") : "", grado: G.some(g => g[0] === par.get("grado")) ? par.get("grado") : "", pub: "", q: ""};
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id), norm = s => s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, "").toLowerCase();
  const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;");
  function chips(el, ops, clave) {
    el.innerHTML = ops.map(o => `<button class="chip-sel ${est[clave] === o[0] ? "on" : ""}" data-v="${o[0]}">${o[1]}</button>`).join("");
    el.querySelectorAll("button").forEach(b => b.onclick = () => { est[clave] = b.dataset.v; pintar(); });
  }
  function pintar() {
    chips($("rec-tipo"), [["", "Todo"], ...Object.entries(T).map(([k, v]) => [k, `${v[0]} ${v[1]}`])], "tipo");
    chips($("rec-grado"), G, "grado"); chips($("rec-pub"), P, "pub");
    const q = norm(est.q).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    const sel = R.filter(r => (!est.tipo || r[4] === est.tipo) && (!est.grado || r[5].includes(est.grado)) && (!est.pub || r[6].includes(est.pub)) &&
      q.every(w => norm(r[2] + " " + r[3]).includes(w)));
    $("rec-n").textContent = `${sel.length} de ${R.length} recursos`;
    $("rec-lista").innerHTML = Object.entries(T).map(([k, v]) => {
      const rs = sel.filter(r => r[4] === k); if (!rs.length) return "";
      return `<h2 class="rec-h" id="${k}">${v[0]} ${v[1]} <small>${v[2]}</small></h2><div class="rec-grid">${rs.map(r =>
        `<a class="rec-card" href="${r[0]}"><span class="rec-i">${r[1]}</span><span><b>${esc(r[2])}</b><small>${esc(r[3])}</small></span></a>`).join("")}</div>`;
    }).join("") || `<p class="pending">Ningún recurso coincide con la búsqueda. Prueba con otras palabras o quita algún filtro.</p>`;
  }
  $("rec-q").addEventListener("input", e => { est.q = e.target.value; pintar(); });
  pintar();
})();
</script>
